entries.en: Passengers began to mill around the closed ticket office.
entries.zh: 乘客们开始在关闭的售票处周围茫然地转悠。

entries.en: A crumpled dollar bill fell from his pocket.
entries.zh: 一张揉皱的一美元钞票从他口袋里掉了出来。

entries.en: The statement records interest paid into the trust account.
entries.zh: 这份报表记录了存入信托账户的利息。

entries.en: The weekend stall can bring in enough to cover materials.
entries.zh: 周末摊位挣的钱可以够付材料费。

entries.en: Please bring up the parking issue at tomorrow's meeting.
entries.zh: 请在明天的会议上提出停车问题。

entries.en: The simulator displays each instruction in machine language.
entries.zh: 模拟器用机器语言显示每条指令。

entries.en: The builder has a strong track record on similar projects.
entries.zh: 这家建筑商在类似项目上有出色的业绩记录。
